info.title: HealthForecast AI
info.description: Hospital Readmission Prediction & Patient Risk Intelligence System. Predicts readmissions, identifies high risk patients, evaluates treatment effectiveness and supports proactive care planning.

post.description:
Register a new account.

The role is assigned by the server. A caller cannot request one, so this
endpoint is not a privilege escalation path. See AuthService.register for how
the first account on an empty database is treated.
Authenticate a user and issue an access token.

get.summary: Return the authenticated caller and their permissions
get.description:
Return the caller's identity, role, permissions and profile.

The frontend reads this after login to decide which dashboard sections to
render. The permission list is the same one the server enforces, so the two
can never disagree about what a role may do.

schema.title: Response Read Me Api V1 Auth Me Get

get.description: Expose the role catalogue and the permissions attached to each role.

schema.title: Response List Roles Api V1 Auth Roles Get

get.description:
Return a page of platform users.

The total matching the current filters is returned in the X-Total-Count
header so the client can paginate without a second endpoint.

post.description: Create a new platform user with the role the administrator chose.

get.description: Return a single user record.

patch.summary: Update a user or assign a role
patch.description:
Apply a partial update, including moving the user to a different role.

Only the fields present in the request body are changed. Removing the last
active system administrator is refused with a 409, because no one could reach
these endpoints afterwards.

get.summary: List patients visible to the caller
get.description:
Return the patients the caller is allowed to see.

Scope rules from the access matrix:
  - doctor          -> only patients assigned to them
  - hospital_admin  -> hospital wide, read only
  - researcher      -> anonymised records only
  - system_admin    -> everything

get.description:
One monthly {period, total, breakdown} series.

- ``outcome``: treatment outcomes by discharge month, broken down by outcome
- ``risk``: risk scores issued per month, broken down by risk category

(/analytics/readmissions, /treatment/recovery-trends).

HospitalAnalyticsSummary.title: HospitalAnalyticsSummary

ModelMetadataRead.description: A registered model version, as returned by the model management endpoints.

PatientAnonymised.title: PatientAnonymised
PatientAnonymised.description: Researcher facing view - no identifiers, no MRN.

PatientCreate.title: PatientCreate
PatientCreate.description: Payload for creating a patient record.

PatientRead.title: PatientRead
PatientRead.description: Patient representation returned to authorised callers.

PatientUpdate.title: PatientUpdate
PatientUpdate.description:
Partial update to a patient record.

Every field is optional and the endpoint serialises with exclude_unset, so an
omitted field keeps its stored value. The medical record number is absent on
purpose: it is the record's identity, not an editable attribute.

PopulationHealthSummary.title: PopulationHealthSummary
PopulationHealthSummary.description:
Aggregated, never row-level, population statistics for researchers.

demographic_distribution keys are "age_group"/"gender"/"race", each
mapping to a {value: count} breakdown - never an individual record.

ReadmissionForecast.title: ReadmissionForecast
ReadmissionForecast.description: Aggregated readmission forecast for a department or hospital.

ReadmissionPredictionRequest.title: ReadmissionPredictionRequest
ReadmissionPredictionRequest.description: Request payload for a 30-day readmission forecast on one admission.

ReadmissionReduction.title: ReadmissionReduction
ReadmissionReduction.description: Readmission rate for one treatment vs. the hospital-wide baseline.

ReadmissionSummary.title: ReadmissionSummary
ReadmissionSummary.description:
Readmission tracking for one patient.

``by_label`` keeps the source dataset's own values (for example NO, <30, >30)
so the readmission window survives, which Milestone 2 forecasting needs.

ReportFilters.title: ReportFilters
ReportFilters.description: Every filter any report type accepts; ALLOWED_FILTERS narrows per type.

RiskDistribution.title: RiskDistribution
RiskDistribution.description: Count of patients per risk band.

readmission_probability.title: Readmission Probability
readmission_probability.description: Experimental model score in [0, 1]; the field name is historical. For prediction_type 'risk' it scores the combined outcome 'in-hospital death or 30-day readmission'; for 'readmission' it scores 30-day readmission after a live discharge. It is not a calibrated probability.

confidence_score.title: Confidence Score
confidence_score.description: Readmission forecasts only: max(score, 1 - score), the distance of the score from 0.5. It is not a measure of whether the prediction is correct.

RiskPredictionRead.title: RiskPredictionRead
RiskPredictionRead.description: A risk score or readmission forecast result for one patient/admission.

RiskPredictionRequest.title: RiskPredictionRequest
RiskPredictionRequest.description:
Request payload for a patient risk score.

Previously carried raw Diabetes-130-US-shaped feature fields
(time_in_hospital, num_lab_procedures, ...) that the /risk/predict stub
never actually read - it always returned a hardcoded probability. Real
inference builds the feature row itself from Postgres
(app/services/ml/feature_builder.py), so the caller only identifies the
patient; it does not - and should not - know the model's feature shape.

Role.title: Role
Role.description: The four operational roles supported by the platform.

Token.title: Token
Token.description: Bearer token returned after a successful login.

TreatmentComparison.title: TreatmentComparison
TreatmentComparison.description: One treatment's figures within a single diagnosis cohort.

TreatmentOutcomeCreate.title: TreatmentOutcomeCreate
TreatmentOutcomeCreate.description: Payload for recording a treatment outcome against an admission.

TreatmentOutcomeDistribution.title: TreatmentOutcomeDistribution
TreatmentOutcomeDistribution.description:
Outcome counts for one treatment - the outcome-vs-treatment cross-tab
of FR-ANL-02. "unrecorded" counts rows whose outcome is NULL.

TrendPoint.title: TrendPoint
TrendPoint.description:
One month of a categorical trend: total count plus a per-label breakdown.

For metric=outcome the labels are treatment outcomes; for metric=risk they
are risk categories.

UserCreate.title: UserCreate
UserCreate.description: Payload accepted when a system administrator creates a user.

UserRead.title: UserRead
UserRead.description: User representation returned by the API.

UserRegister.title: UserRegister
UserRegister.description:
Self service registration payload.

Carries no role field on purpose: the role is decided by the server, never by
the caller, so a registration request cannot ask for elevated privileges.

UserUpdate.title: UserUpdate
UserUpdate.description:
Partial update applied by a system administrator.

Every field is optional and the endpoint serialises with exclude_unset, so a
field the caller omits keeps its stored value rather than being blanked.
Assigning ``role`` is how a user is moved between roles.
